title: Media query observation
description: Leaf event written by the Ray.MediaQuery observation adapter for one successful .sql invocation: intent (name + params) and wall time. The file may contain several statements; the duration covers the batch, and a failure anywhere in it throws before the logger seam fires, so nothing is recorded. rows_ref is reserved for a richer upstream logger contract that exposes result rows.

params.description: Converted query parameters; an empty map serializes as an empty JSON array. Binary values arrive base64-encoded.

rows_ref.description: Storage pointer to externalized result rows; not emitted by the current adapter.
